text: The paper reports that supervised learning needed tens of millions of examples to learn these algorithms, while Iterated Amplification needed tens of thousands of examples to learn the simpler decompositions (Table 2 lists 6,000 to 24,000 oracle calls per task). The authors expect sample complexity to be much larger for realistic tasks where modelling H may need a high-quality language model.
